scope: One CPU-only read of each completed saved checkpoint. Native report counters are separate from this analysis cost.

saved_native_consumption.scope: Actual learning interval, separate from generation token cost. Completed backward counts are lower bounds if a row is interrupted; no extra backward for support and no old v037 cache.

saved_support_gradient_receipt.scope: Actual original B leaf gradients, summed in original row order within each slot/member. Group sums support direction inspection only; they never replace native weighted Q+/- backwards or prove optimizer sensitivity.

B.gradient_scope: Pre-clip norms and support gradient groups copied from native receipts; no probability or gradient recomputation.

analysis_only_revision_before_first_stat: Added completed worker/checkpoint/source/S0 bindings and explicit version-field comparison; frozen implementation and original reporter untouched.

direction.scope: A single supported local finite direction. Actual optimizer sensitivity and development utility remain to be measured; zero or absent I freedom does not remove G-raw within-class freedom.

analysis_cost.clock_scope: Start of analysis through completed evidence/state comparison; output serialization excluded.
